name: Axy
source:
A real goofball, cute as a button, Axy cares about having a good time. Obsessed with doing the coolest somersault in order to impress the love of his life: Lanna.

[spoiler]ALLEN's natural innocent side and the manifestation of his pure carefree childlike energy.[/spoiler]
